findings.summary: input_commit, subject_commit, and implementation_subject_commit are byte-identical (all e2035e37ab6d1647c32ec340d68e3436d71d4bc4), satisfying the contract's same-commit requirement. Product consistency between work_head_commit befb93387414d5dbfadcfdced1080d38f3008899 and the subject commit could not be mechanically verified via git diff (read-only inspection only), but file inspection shows the materialization commit stacks only reserved .dev-dispatch/ namespace metadata (the implement handoff JSON) on the product tip, consistent with a compliant metadata-only materialization; the deterministic seal independently verifies HEAD.
